title: Duplicate issue check
description: Decide whether a new issue duplicates one issue of a shortlist, or one given candidate

candidates.description: the shortlist, profile strict: {id, summary} per candidate; 'none' is added

candidate.description: profile pair: the one candidate issue

profile.description: strict picks from the candidates shortlist; pair compares with one candidate

dupe_of.instructions: Which candidate issue (if any) is the same underlying problem as the NEW issue? Pick 'none' unless one clearly matches.

extra.none: None of the candidates is the same problem

dup.instructions: Is the NEW issue describing the same underlying problem as the CANDIDATE issue, such that one could be closed in favour of the other?

criteria.true: Same root problem and same symptom; fixing one fixes the other
criteria.false: Different problem, even if it touches the same component or keywords

combine: duplicate if dupe_of != 'none' and dupe_of.p >= dupe_p; duplicate if dup >= dup_yes; unsure if dupe_of != 'none'; unsure if dup >= dup_human; not_duplicate otherwise
limitations: dedupe is only as good as the shortlist
the shortlist must be part of each row's state when run as a batch
the duplicate is signals.dupe_of in the shortlist profile
notes: # deviation: spec 2.18 lists duplicate, not_duplicate; `unsure` is added for the human band (shortlist p_top below 0.6, pair 0.4-0.85) and as the open-failure decision; candidates is an array of {id, summary} (not an object); the pair candidate is the optional `candidate` input of profile pair
